meta.description: Saved Phase 4G audit of a synthetic three-junction corridor. Values are recalculated from committed CSV records; no simulation is run.
meta.bootstrap: 4,000 percentile resamples of paired seed differences, generator seed 2026

strategy_descriptions.Phase3A: Original coordinated baseline: common Webster-based cycle, fixed green splits and design-speed eastbound offsets.
strategy_descriptions.Phase4E: Fairness-protected offsets selected separately for each period; cycles and green splits unchanged from Phase 3A.
strategy_descriptions.Integrated: Phase 4E plans, with only the PM peak Junction C green split and offsets replaced by the Phase 4F-3B joint selection.
